items.prompt: An old schoolfriend asks if you ever pass your old school. Which reply fits best?
options: Sometimes! The yard still looks great, I always wave at it.
Sometimes. The yard looks smaller now, and the voices are gone.
items.target: Sometimes. The yard looks smaller now, and the voices are gone.

items.prompt: Your daughter asks about the photo of you at twenty. Which reply fits best?
options: That was the summer I turned twenty, in Lisbon with friends.
Ah, that summer. It all felt endless then; it slipped away quietly.
items.target: Ah, that summer. It all felt endless then; it slipped away quietly.

items.prompt: A friend asks how it felt to visit your hometown last month. Which reply fits best?
options: Strange. The bakery's gone, the streets echo. I lingered a while.
Awful. I sat in the car and cried the whole way back home.
items.target: Strange. The bakery's gone, the streets echo. I lingered a while.

items.prompt: Someone asks why you keep that old record player. Which reply fits best?
options: It was my father's; the crackle brings back slow Sunday afternoons.
It was my father's, and it still plays records perfectly well.
items.target: It was my father's; the crackle brings back slow Sunday afternoons.

items.prompt: A colleague asks how your last day at the old office went. Which reply fits best?
options: Quick! Packed the desk by noon and straight on to the next thing.
Slow. I sat by the window a while, thinking of all those years.
items.target: Slow. I sat by the window a while, thinking of all those years.

items.prompt: A neighbour asks about the empty house across the road. Which reply fits best?
options: The Morrisons lived there for decades. It's on the market now, I think.
The Morrisons lived there for decades. Odd how a house forgets its people.
items.target: The Morrisons lived there for decades. Odd how a house forgets its people.

items.prompt: Your partner asks what was on your mind during the evening walk. Which reply fits best?
options: Old friends, mostly. How we drifted apart, the way autumn comes.
Nothing much. Just the light and the quiet. It was nice.
items.target: Old friends, mostly. How we drifted apart, the way autumn comes.

items.prompt: A friend asks why you went back to the seaside town. Which reply fits best?
options: To walk the pier like we did as children, one last time.
To walk the pier like we did as children, and it was brilliant fun!
items.target: To walk the pier like we did as children, one last time.

items.prompt: Your sister asks how it was clearing out Gran's attic. Which reply fits best?
options: Unbearable. I sat on the floor and sobbed for an hour.
Her letters, her hats... a whole life folded into boxes.
items.target: Her letters, her hats... a whole life folded into boxes.

items.prompt: A student asks what the university was like in your day. Which reply fits best?
options: Another world. The old library, the long talks, all gone now.
Smaller. One library, two cafés, and far fewer students than now.
items.target: Another world. The old library, the long talks, all gone now.

items.prompt: Your friend asks how your band's reunion gig went. Which reply fits best?
options: Gentle. We played the old songs and felt how far we'd drifted.
Fast and loud. We blasted through the set and wanted more.
items.target: Gentle. We played the old songs and felt how far we'd drifted.

items.prompt: Your son asks why you still keep his baby shoes. Which reply fits best?
options: They're yours, darling. Every time I see them I want to hug you.
They're from a time that went by too fast. I like to hold them.
items.target: They're from a time that went by too fast. I like to hold them.

items.prompt: A friend asks how the autumn has been for you. Which reply fits best?
options: Quiet. The leaves fall, the evenings shorten, and I think of other autumns.
Great! Crunchy leaves, bonfires, I love every single bit of it!
items.target: Quiet. The leaves fall, the evenings shorten, and I think of other autumns.

items.prompt: Someone asks if you miss living in the city. Which reply fits best?
options: Now and then. The late trams, the old crowd... another life.
Not really. Life here is quiet and that suits me well.
items.target: Now and then. The late trams, the old crowd... another life.

items.prompt: A colleague asks about the old photo on your desk. Which reply fits best?
options: That's my first team, at the plant in Leeds, back in 2004.
My first team, at the plant in Leeds. Most have drifted off since.
items.target: My first team, at the plant in Leeds. Most have drifted off since.

items.prompt: Your granddaughter asks what the village was like when you were young. Which reply fits best?
options: Fields where the estate is now, and one shop by the old church.
Fields where the estate is now. I still see them when I close my eyes.
items.target: Fields where the estate is now. I still see them when I close my eyes.
